status: DESIGNED, NOT EXECUTED. Preconditions: (1) prospective confirmation of ITMG-C1 and I1 (>= 8 journaled quarters); (2) >= 8 quarters of forward consensus snapshots for ITMG (started 2026-11-24). No historical consensus exists, so expectations-gap tests cannot be run retrospectively.
questions: Does the I1 gross-profit nowcast differ from consensus-implied quarterly expectations (expectations gap)?
Do analysts revise ITMG estimates in the direction of the gap after results?
Are ITMG factor-adjusted returns around results related to the gap, before and after transaction costs?

signals.gap: I1 nowcast (made at quarter end + 10 days) minus consensus-implied quarter (FY consensus EPS snapshot x shares minus reported YTD profit, converted to GP using trailing GP/net-profit ratio; documented approximation)

events: ITMG quarterly results filings (IDX timestamps; A-018 timing rule)
returns: daily total returns (S-002); abnormal = ITMG minus (beta_IHSG x IHSG + beta_coal x EW coal peers ex-self [PTBA, ADRO, BUMI where liquid] + beta_newc x Newcastle change), betas estimated on a 250-day window ending 20 days before the event
analyst_revisions: change in FY consensus EPS from the last snapshot before results to the first snapshot 10+ trading days after
costs: 0.45% round trip (0.15% buy + 0.25% sell incl. 0.10% sales tax + slippage; EST for ITMG liquidity ~IDR 38bn/day) applied to any return claim
inference: rank correlation (gap, CAR) and sign test; HAC/bootstrap; Holm across the 3 windows; minimum 12 events
pass_rule: post-window net CAR in the gap direction > 0 with Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 AND revisions in the gap direction with p <= 0.05
non_goals: no trading system, no position sizing, no BUY; ASP or GP forecasting accuracy alone is not alpha
